transcript.text: Hello, this is a call from Mumbai Bank. May I speak with Rakesh Sharma?
Haan haan theek hai, this is Rakesh speaking. Who is this again?

Thank you for confirming. I am calling from Mumbai Bank regarding your credit card account.

Our records show that a minimum payment of Rs 4820 was due on 2026-10-15 and has not been received yet. I am here to assist you with this pending payment.

May I know when you are planning to make this payment, and for what amount?
Sorry, could you say that again? I didn’t quite catch the date or the amount.

Of course, I can repeat that for you.

The minimum payment due is Rs 4,820, and the due date was 2026-10-15. This amount is still pending on your credit card account.

Could you please let me know when you will be able to pay this amount?
Haan haan theek hai, I understand. But what exactly is a minimum payment? Is that like the full amount I owe or something else?

Great question! The minimum payment is the smallest amount you are required to pay by the due date to keep your account in good standing. It is not the total outstanding balance—you may owe more on your card, but paying at least the minimum helps you avoid additional late fees.

If you pay only the minimum, the remaining balance will carry forward and interest will be charged at 3.5% per month on the unpaid amount.

If you would like to know your full outstanding balance, I can verify your identity by sending you a one-time password (OTP). Would you like to proceed with this verification?
Haan haan theek hai. But can you please repeat the part about the interest again? I didn’t get the number you said.

Absolutely. The interest charged on any outstanding credit card balance is 3.5% per month. 

This interest is applied to any amount that remains unpaid after the due date. If you have any other questions, please let me know. 

May I know when you plan to make the minimum payment of Rs 4,820?
Haan haan theek hai. I think I understand now. Umm, can I pay by next Friday? Would that be alright?
Thank you for letting me know. Next Friday is 2026-11-06. To confirm, will you be able to pay at least the minimum amount of Rs 4,820 by that date?
Haan haan theek hai. Yes, I will pay the amount by then. Thank you.
